families.title: Affine physical cube and quantitative primitive inverse
families.domain: Specified 7D affine unit cube, fixed D/f, uniform mu in [1e9,1.5e9] eV/H.
families.claim: Invertible constant row transform preserves seven finite residuals. Whole cube has positive simplex/cone and warm primitive before differentiating. Explicit inverse/temperature/velocity/density/Doppler operator bounds hold.
limitations: Coordinate-specific inverse norm, not an unscaled global condition-number theorem.
